research.title: Surface Defect Classification with Texture Descriptors
bullets: Prepared inspection images by standardizing intensity ranges, checking defect annotations, and separating training and evaluation sets by source specimen.
Implemented a supplied texture classification baseline using local binary patterns and support vector machines, documenting errors associated with uneven illumination.

research.title: Leaf Condition Recognition from Color and Texture Features
bullets: Organized leaf photographs, reviewed condition labels, and grouped images by plant specimen to prevent overlap between training and evaluation sets.
Implemented prescribed color histogram and texture baselines with scikit-learn classifiers, summarizing confusion patterns across leaf conditions and background variations.

publications.title: Color and Texture Baselines for Leaf Condition Recognition under Background Variation

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Processing Maintenance
bullets: Maintained Python validation routines for uploaded images, checking file metadata and handling malformed inputs within an existing processing workflow.
Added regression tests for image processing failures, reproduced reported defects, and documented expected behavior for maintenance handoffs.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented a course specified image retrieval baseline using normalized color histograms and nearest neighbor ranking over a labeled image collection.
Compared retrieved examples against category labels and inspected failures caused by similar color distributions across visually distinct objects.
